events.title: Trump v. CASA, Inc., et al.; Trump v. Washington, et al.; Trump v. New Jersey, et al.
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted the motion of respondents for divided argument in the cases involving Trump, President of the U.S., et al. against CASA, Inc., Washington, and New Jersey. This procedural decision allows the respondents to split their oral argument time among multiple parties, which can be significant in complex cases involving multiple respondents with potentially differing interests or arguments.
events.why_relevant: The granting of divided argument can affect the presentation and consideration of complex legal issues before the Court.

events.title: Supreme Court grants stay in United States v. Shilling
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted a stay of the preliminary injunction entered by the United States District Court for the Western District of Washington in the case United States, et al. v. Shilling, Commander, et al. This stay will remain in effect pending the outcome of the appeal in the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals and any subsequent petition for a writ of certiorari. If certiorari is denied, the stay will automatically terminate. If certiorari is granted, the stay will terminate upon the issuance of the Supreme Court's judgment. Justices Sotomayor, Kagan, and Jackson dissented from the decision to grant the stay.
events.why_relevant: The stay affects the enforcement of a lower court's injunction, impacting the legal proceedings and potential outcomes.
